resources.string: Everything for your PDFs in one app
Read, annotate, sign, fill forms, scan documents and organize pages — no internet needed.
Right-to-left interface, clear Arabic fonts, Arabic text recognition and read-aloud.
Your files stay on your device
No account needed. Your documents are never uploaded unless you choose to (cloud, shared review, AI assistant).
By using the app you agree to the privacy policy. Choose whether to help us with anonymous statistics.
Helps us improve the app. Never includes your files or identity. You can change this later on the Help page.
Pick a PDF from your device or any installed cloud storage app.
Photograph paper pages to get a clean PDF, with Arabic text recognition.
Switch between view, comment, edit and sign with these tabs.
Tools of the current tab live here: pick a tool, then tap the page.
No. Reading, editing, signing, scanning and text recognition work offline. Internet is needed only for cloud, shared review, the AI assistant, and the first download of OCR language data.
A file opened from another app is edited as a copy inside the app folder, and changes are written back to the original whenever the system allows it. You can always save or share a copy.
How do I sign a document?
Open the file, go to the Fill & Sign tab, create your signature by drawing, typing or from a photo, then tap where it goes. For certificate-based signatures use the Digital signature tool.
OCR does not read Arabic well
Use sharp, well-lit images of a flat page and select Arabic among the recognition languages. Higher resolution gives better results.
How do I move files to my computer?
In Cloud choose Wi‑Fi transfer. Join the same network, open the shown address in the computer\'s browser or scan the QR code, then enter the 6-digit PIN.
How do I connect Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox?
In the Cloud tab pick the provider and sign in. Files open in the reader and saving uploads the changes to the same cloud file.
You send a file to colleagues with a link and code; each adds comments in the app and everyone sees everyone\'s comments (refreshed every 30 seconds) until the deadline.
Yes, all on-device PDF tools are currently free. Pro is optional and supports development and server-based features.

Sync runs both ways about every hour. If a file changed on both sides, the Drive version is kept as “(نسخة متعارضة)” next to your file. Deleting on one side deletes on the other (Drive files go to the trash).

Send and receive files from a computer with a PIN
Start the transfer, then open the address in a browser on any device on the same Wi‑Fi, or scan the QR code. You will be asked for the 6-digit PIN shown here.
Open this address in the computer\'s browser or scan the code:
Transfer stopped after 10 minutes without activity
Nobody can connect without the PIN, which changes on every start. The connection is not encrypted, so use it only on a network you trust.
